cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: Continuous lateral contour showing a shallow concave transition between the superior orbital ridge and the start of the nasal bridge, followed by a linear descending plane to the nasal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of low-luminance pixels on the mid-to-posterior flank and a distinct dark circular marking on the proximal lateral surface of the right hind limb.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast black pigmentation on the posterior surface of the pinnae and a prominent horizontal boundary separating the tawny dorsal fur from the white ventral fur.
